messages:
ash p: quick follow-up from last night's multi-pager on KV cache. want tidy owners + short timelines so this doesn't become a recurring churn.
ash p: nutshell: deploy + shard moves exposed noisy redis alerts that currently page on any short spike. want to lock down 4 concrete actions and owners below.
ash p: actions (bite sized):
  1) replace ephemeral instance-based dedupe with stable shard+region fingerprint
  2) implement a sliding sustain + repage backoff for shard-level rules
  3) add per-tenant top-n suppression so noisy tenants don't drown pages
  4) temporarily lower paging sensitivity during the rollout and run a 72h noise audit after
please claim owner + ETA (date or "tomorrow EOD").
gabi r: i'll take #1. plan: change dedupe template to use `shard` and `zone` labels, add unit test that replays a shard relocation. ETA: Thu EOD (2024-05-02).
noah_c: i'll pick #2. idea: sliding window `for: 60s` -> `for: 180s` with `repage_block: 15m` annotation. will open a config PR and run staging replay. ETA: today EOD (2024-04-29).
ethan_z: i'll own #3 and #4. for suppression: implement top-5 per-tenant noise suppression and add a short silence during rollout (48h). i'll schedule the 72h audit and post results at 24/72h. ETA: routing + monitor by Mon AM (2024-05-06).
pager-bot: Incident KV-2024-04-29 acknowledged by ash p. Temporary silence set by ethan_z for #pager-duty until 2024-05-01T08:00Z.
noah_c: config snippet for #2:
```yaml
- alert: RedisShardHighLoad
  expr: redis_shard_load{role="kv"} > 0.9
  for: 180s
  labels:
    severity: warning
    dedupe_key: "{{ $labels.shard }}|{{ $labels.zone }}"
  annotations:
    repage_block: 15m
```
gabi r: on #1 i'll also scan other alerts that still template on `instance` and submit a small linter rule to catch future regressions.
ash p: can each owner drop a one-liner ETA so i can add to the PM tracker? i'll schedule a 15m check-in next Thu to confirm closure.
gabi r: ETA Thu EOD (2024-05-02) - PR + tests.
noah_c: ETA 2024-04-29 EOD - config PR + staging replay.
ethan_z: ETA 2024-05-06 AM - suppression rollout + monitor scheduled.
ash p: after deploy we'll run the 72h audit. who can own the noise report and short remediation notes if we see regressions?
noah_c: i'll run the replay and post a 24h/72h summary in this thread.
ethan_z: i'll aggregate results and open follow-up tickets if any rule still repages.
ash p: blockers? anything we should escalate to infra or product comms?
gabi r: none on dedupe side.
noah_c: infra has bandwidth for replay - no blockers.
ethan_z: product comms not needed unless customer-visible errors appear; will escalate if so.
ash p: thanks all. i'll update the postmortem with these owners/timelines and add the check-in invite. re-open thread if anything slips. :thumbsup:
